$comment: How the bridge drives djay Pro, by keyboard shortcut. Cmd-Return (musicLibrary.markSelectedSongs, adds the selection to the Queue) and Shift-Cmd-Return (mixer.transitionActiveToInactive, mixes into the next deck) are taken from djay's own key bindings on the DJ laptop. Still to confirm by hand: that Cmd-F focuses the library search, and that Down then selects the first song - not an artist, album or playlist, because opening one replaces what Automix plays from (see README.md, 'Calibrating'). The search is cleared afterwards with Cmd-F then Escape (a macOS search field clears on Escape); confirm that too. {query} is replaced with 'title artist'.
